name: Input
usage: Form fields, search fields in toolbars, entering a name in a dialog

props.name: prefix
props.description: Content before the text, inside the field, such as an icon.

props.name: type
props.description:
Native input type, such as `email`, `tel` or `url`. The date and time types show the browser's own picker;
prefer DatePicker and TimePicker for a consistent look.

props.name: numeric
props.description:
Tabular numbers for numeric input such as amounts, quantities and reference numbers: every digit has the same
width, which makes values easy to align and check (same as `<Text numeric>`).

props.name: ref
props.description: Handle of the field.

props.name: value
props.description: Current text (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every change of the text, with the native change event (`e.target.value`).

props.name: onPressEnter
props.description: Called when `Enter` is pressed.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item: `error` or `warning` colors the field.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Appearance: `filled` (a borderless well in the surface, the default), `outlined` (surface background with a thin
border) or `borderless` (no background, for fields inside other surfaces such as a command palette).

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has text.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content after the text, inside the field, such as a unit.

props.name: maxLength
props.description:
Largest number of characters, a native attribute: the field does not accept more (typing stops at the limit and
pasted text is cut). To let people type more and show an error message instead, leave it out and use a Form
rule `{ max, message }`. With `showCount`, the counter shows the limit.

props.name: showCount
props.description:
Shows a character counter at the end of the field: the number of characters, and the limit with `maxLength`
("12 / 100"). Screen readers do not read it on every keystroke; they read the count, such as "12 of 100
characters", as the description of the field when it gets the focus.

members.name: Input.Password
members.summary:
Password input: the text is masked, and a button at the end of the field shows it as plain text
(`visibilityToggle`, on by default). Otherwise the same as Input.

props.name: visibilityToggle
props.description: Shows the button that toggles between hidden and visible text.

members.name: Input.Search
members.summary:
Search input: a search icon at the start of the field and no attached button. `Enter` calls `onSearch` with the
text (not while an input method is composing, nor while `loading`); with `allowClear`, the clear button calls it
with an empty string. `loading` turns the icon into a spinning loading indicator. Renders `type="search"`, so
screen readers announce a search field.

props.name: onSearch
props.description:
Search: called with the current text when `Enter` is pressed, and with an empty string when the clear button of
`allowClear` is clicked (`info.source` is `clear`). `Enter` while composing text with an input method, and while
`loading`, does not search.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Searching: the search icon in the field becomes a spinning loading indicator, and `Enter` does not search again
meanwhile.

members.name: Input.TextArea
members.summary:
Multi-line text input, such as for descriptions and comments; `autoSize` makes it grow with the content. Its ref
is a handle (`TextAreaRef`) with `focus`, `blur` and the native `textarea`.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Single-line text, password, search and multi-line text.

examples.name: Search
examples.title: Search
examples.description:
The search icon sits at the start inside the box, with no attached button: `Enter` triggers `onSearch`, and with
`allowClear` the clear button triggers it with an empty string as well. While `loading`, the icon becomes a
loading indicator and `Enter` does not trigger it again.

examples.name: Numeric
examples.title: Tabular numbers
examples.description:
Add `numeric` to inputs for amounts, quantities and IDs: digits have the same width, which makes values easier to
align and check. Pass amounts as strings, never as floating-point numbers.
